interpretation_limit: This is cross-entry transfer from one 1BNA structure to two sequence-covered windows among nine fixed windows in one 1KX5 target entry. It reduces direct same-entry leakage but does not establish independent-family generalization, environment compatibility, or structural acceptance. Relaxed thresholds are diagnostic only.

early_gate_sensitivity.interpretation: Exploratory sensitivity only: endpoint rotation and anchor-atom limits were relaxed to expose which later gates reject candidates. Not a valid closure threshold.
